title: Splitting the ray integral of a test 1-form at t = 1 (parent step 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P) be a test 1-form on ℝ^P (TestFormOn univ 1: C^∞ with compact support) and let e ∈ ℝ^P with |e| = 1. Then ∫_{(0,∞)} ω(te)(e) dt = ∫_{(0,1)} ω(te)(e) dt + ∫_{(1,∞)} ω(te)(e) dt, where ω(x)(e) denotes the value of the 1-covector ω(x) on the 1-tuple (e) (fun _ => e) and the integrals are Lebesgue (Bochner) integrals over the indicated subsets of ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (e : Euclid P), ‖e‖ = 1 → ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e) = (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) + ∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
